Do you have an appointment already?
You're supposed to upload the documents at least 3 months before the appointment (if that's passed already, upload it as quickly as possible).
In general you would only have to bring updated documents but to be sure I'd bring everything with you.

If you haven't uploaded them yet, this is the link.
